reason: The next_task registration resolves a tasks.json path and optional complexity report path, then calls an(), which reads task data from those paths and returns the selected task object in the MCP response. That supports SECRET because local project/task file contents are returned to the agent context. It also supports UNTRUSTED because returned task fields come from project/task files that can contain user-controlled content. The shown next_task path does not execute arbitrary host commands/code, and it does not send agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable external destination; logging/internal responses are not SINKs.
